title: Reopening a saved cadence loses the visible weekday/time selection
status: fixed; host and API 30/34 debug verified
reproduction: Open a restored weekly profile such as TravelRestore at Thursday 17:23. Reopen the cadence, weekday and time stages and confirm without changing the time. Compare daily global and URL entries.
expected: Mark the saved cadence/day and initialize from the stored local clock time; cancelling or confirming unchanged should not mutate schedules.
observed: Parent reported the signed-restore UI result. Static baseline used plain list rows and initialized both time dialogs from Calendar.getInstance(). Global/URL confirmation also rewrote last-run state.
fix: Use a shared checked picker for manager global/set/URL and Sources set editing, keep unsaved wall-clock defaults, and call the writer only for confirmed changes.
test_evidence: 33 host tests passed (25 DiscoverPresetSubscriptionTest, 6 FilterSetStoreTest, 2 FilterSetUpdateWorkerTest). Six connected methods passed twice (11.907s and 7.523s) on API 30 debug emulator-5598. The initial API 34 shard reported three focus failures and a missing URL last-run after OK; the worker does not remove that key. Exact cause of the original missing key is unknown; it did not recur on unchanged production code. title: Turning off the final configured schedule still enqueues periodic work
reproduction: Turn Off an edited schedule with another independent schedule configured, then turn Off the last one. Compare unfinished FilterSetUpdateWork requests.
expected: Keep a single dispatcher while any global, named or URL cadence is configured; cancel when none remain.
observed: Editor callbacks unconditionally invoked enable(), including after saving Off; only the separate reconciliation path checked for any remaining schedules.
fix: Call existing syncPreferences after schedule commits on both edited screens. No worker, receiver, service or backup changes.
test_evidence: New editor-driven WorkManager cases cover global Off with named remaining, toolbar last Off, manager named Off with URL remaining and manager URL last Off. Both dispatcher cases passed in both API 30 debug runs (5598) and both API 34 debug runs (5578). All six existing reconciliation cases passed in platform-restore/picker-34-neighbors.txt. The three separate service cases were not part of these targeted replays.

title: Older schedule tests can act on the wrong window during dialog transitions
reproduction: Run the six picker cases followed by the existing schedule editing and reconciliation suites on API 34 (5578).
expected: Wait for the resumed Sources toolbar and actual chooser row before advancing to snapshot collision assertions.
observed: platform-restore/picker-34-neighbors.txt: 18/19; all six new picker and six reconciliation cases passed. Only confirmDailySelectionUsesPendingSnapshotAndAvoidsNewNameCollision timed out clicking Current selection. Then final-picker-34.txt: the chooser passed; the Back check failed. At 04:31:36 global Back finished HomeActivity while the daily TimePickerDialog was still attached, followed by a dismissal timeout.
fix: Wait for the focused chooser row. For Back on API 29+, dispatch a real key down/up to the focused picker decor, then require that decor to detach and the same Sources toolbar to regain focus before checking saved state. No product change or added delays.
